answer: A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in ridge, and sparrow reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 168 aliases, and each one needs its own funded comet account. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 7 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
